keyPoints: Koshika (cell) jeevan ki sabse chhoti ikai hai — sabhi jeev koshikaon se bane hain.
Koshika ke 3 mukhya hisse: koshika jhilli (membrane), koshika-dravya (cytoplasm) aur kendrak (nucleus).
Kendrak koshika ka 'dimaag' hai — koshika ki sabhi kriyaon ko control karta hai.
Paudhon ki koshika me 2 extra hisse hote hain: koshika-bhitti (cell wall) aur harit-lavak (chloroplast).
Harit-lavak me chlorophyll hota hai — paudhon me photosynthesis yahin hota hai.
Mitochondria koshika ka 'powerhouse' hai — yahin urja banti hai.
Amoeba ek-koshikiya jeev hai, jabki manav bahu-koshikiya — karodon koshikaon se bana hai.
